name: Brushed-Copper Over-Ear Headphones
description: A pair of over-ear headphones with matte charcoal-grey composite ear cups, a brushed-copper metal headband and hinges, and protein-leather cushioned earpads.
materials: matte charcoal-grey composite ear cups, brushed-copper metal headband and hinges, protein-leather cushioned earpads and headband padding
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraving, or printing anywhere on the ear cups, headband, or hinges; never render a third ear cup or a mismatched hinge finish; never omit the copper hinge detail Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: the brushed-copper headband and hinge finish, matte charcoal ear-cup color, protein-leather cushioning, and completely plain unmarked surfaces must read identically in every angle, same hinge geometry throughout When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
